FORTISBC ENERGY INC.
For the Year Ended December 31, 2025
February 11, 2026
The Corporation is serving approximately 1,104,500 residential, commercial, industrial, and transportation customers.
In November 2024, the BCUC approved a 2025 forecast average rate base of $6,470 million. In July 2025, FEI filed an updated 2025 forecast average rate base of $6,452 million, and a 2026 forecast average rate base of $6,835 million.

The 2026 projected capital expenditures are approximately $1,151 million. The 2025 capital expenditures were $1,261 million.
Both 2025 and 2024 net earnings are based on an allowed ROE of 9.65 percent and a deemed equity component of capital structure of 45 percent.
The assumed discount rate, used to measure the projected pension benefit obligations, is 4.80 per cent.
